items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Mike Maestry and his dad, about three or four brothers.

ctx.x: Did he have rooms upstairs for them?

Yeah, I think he had upstairs. He had a nice place there on Ramport Street there. Is that the one they call the annex? Yeah, I believe it is. Between Canal and... You'll see. On this corner there was mush... Not mush there. Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Funniture store. Oh. That's that old furniture store there was there. Uh... Uh... Name after that old mayor... Maestry? Maestry. Maestry's furniture store was there. Mike Maestry and his dad, about three or four brothers. Uh-huh. Had the furniture store right at the…
I've seen a picture of that place.
